supplementaryReferences.note: This exact Grewia species is recorded as food. August–December is flowering and cannot be copied into fruit-picking cells.

care: SANBI records it in arid Karoo and Eastern Cape scrub, with frost and drought tolerance. It can grow in sun or semi-shade.
purchase: Ask for Grewia robusta, not the unrelated Grevillea robusta. The checked source gives no named fruit cultivar.
